Going to a teacher just to check what you already know is a waste of time.

Kevin Trudeau shares a teaching on the qualities of a sincere student. If you go to learn with a cup that is already full, even good wisdom has nowhere to go. The teacher would love to pour, but it overflows and goes to waste.

Kevin's advice is to go empty and open: "I'm an open cup, please pour in all you can."

Where in your life is your cup already full?

#ad #mindset #success #kevintrudeau

"I came only to learn. Why should I work for you?"

Kevin Trudeau shares an old teaching on service. Some students say they can work anywhere, but selfless service shows obedience and a mind ready to receive. Through service, the teacher passes on the teaching, because mere words are not enough.

Physics and chemistry can't be taught just from books. The student has to go into the lab and work. With spiritual knowledge, the lab is the entire world, and the teacher may say, go and wash the toilet.

Would you do the humble job to earn the lesson?

#ad #success #habits #kevintrudeau
